list.title: Users
list.subtitle: Manage the people who have access to your organization.
list.emptyBody: Invite your first user, or adjust the filters if you expected to see someone here.
list.tableHint: Click on a user to see their details and manage their access.

roleDesc.tenant_admin: Administrators have full access to the admin panel and must enable MFA.
roleDesc.formador: Trainers can create and manage courses, quizzes and grading.
roleDesc.alumno: Students consume the published courses of the organization.
roleDesc.auditor: Auditors can review the audit log and certificates.
roleDesc.empresa_manager: Managers see analytics and members of their company.
roleDesc.inspector: Inspectors follow the subsidised groups granted to them: they can browse the course and read tracking data, but change nothing.

invite.title: Invite person
invite.subtitle: We will send them an email with a link to set their password and sign in.
invite.cardDescription: The email must be unique within your organization. The role can be changed later.
invite.groupHint: They are enrolled in the courses of the group right away: when they set their password they will land in a ready classroom, not an empty campus.

import.title: Import CSV
import.subtitle: Register several people at once. All of them get the same role and (if you pick one) the same access group; each one receives their own email to set a password.
import.cardDescription: The CSV needs an email column (or correo); a name/nombre column is optional. Rows without a valid email are ignored.
import.groupHint: Everyone in the CSV gets enrolled in the courses of this group.
import.parseNoRows: We found no rows with a valid email (check the "email" column).
import.parseTooMany: The file has {count} rows and the maximum per upload is {max}. Split it into several CSV files.
import.parseReadError: We could not read the file.
import.foundRows: We found {count} {count, plural, one {valid person} other {valid people}} in the file.
import.alreadyRunning: An import is already running; wait for it to finish.
import.progressHint: It goes one by one. It runs on the server: you can close this page without stopping it.
import.ctaCount: Import {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

groups.title: Access groups
groups.subtitle: Define which set of courses each member can see. The group marked as “default” is assigned automatically when an enrollment request is approved.
groups.newDescription: Create an access group and then assign courses and members to it.
groups.markedDefault: Marked as the default group on approval.
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete the group? Its members will lose their access.
groups.allCoursesInfo: This group grants access to all published courses. It does not require selecting courses.
groups.tierHelp: If you link a tier, users whose effective tier matches are added to this group (and enrolled in its courses) when you press “Sync tiers from payments”. Downgrading removes them. It does not affect members added manually.
groups.tierLinkedNotice: Group linked to tier “{name}”. Members with that tier are reconciled when payments are synced.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.subtitle: Who has received the classroom invitation, who has ended up signing in, and who is still missing.
invitations.noAccessDetail: They would land in an empty classroom
invitations.batchDescription: It is sent only to those who have not yet received the invitation, so you can repeat it without fear of writing to anyone twice. Emails go out one by one with a pause between them: sent all at once, the domain ends up flagged as spam, and that would also drag down password and certificate emails.
invitations.groupHint: Each person in the batch is added to this group (without removing the ones they already had), so they arrive to a ready classroom instead of an empty campus.
invitations.nobodyLeft: No one is left to invite. New accounts will show up here as they are created.
invitations.alreadyRunning: A batch is already running. Wait for it to finish before launching another one.
invitations.progressHint: It goes one by one, so it takes about a second per email. It runs on the server: you can close this page without stopping it.
invitations.empty: There is no one on this list yet.

requests.title: Enrollment requests
requests.subtitle: Members who requested access, pending validation. For each one, their subscription is looked up across all connected payment accounts and the matching tier is preselected (you can change it before approving).
requests.mapLabel: Is the subscription under another email? Map it here
requests.lookupNotYet: The subscription has not been checked yet.
requests.lookupErrorDetail: ⚠ The subscription could not be verified: {error}. Check that the payment accounts are connected and try the lookup again.
requests.lookupError: ⚠ The subscription could not be verified. Check that the payment accounts are connected and try the lookup again.
requests.noSubscription: No subscription detected in the connected payment accounts.
requests.subNotEntitled: ⚠ Subscription not active — canceled or past due ({count})

registration.title: Member registration
registration.description: How people join your community through /inscripcion-miembros: choose which verifications you require before each request reaches you. The final approval is always yours (1-click email or the requests panel).
registration.telegramOption: Membership of your Telegram group (Login Widget)
registration.modeClosed: Registration CLOSED: no one can request access; accounts are created by the administrator.
registration.modeBoth: The applicant verifies their Telegram (group membership) and their email with a code before sending the request.
registration.modeTelegram: The applicant verifies their Telegram (group membership); the email is collected without verification.
registration.modeOtp: The applicant verifies their email with a 6-digit code before sending the request.
registration.modeFree: Registration OPEN: anyone can send a request; the only gate is your manual approval.
registration.botUsernameHint: Required to show the Login Widget on the public form.
registration.groupIdHint: Numeric ID of the group/supergroup (with the -100 prefix for supergroups).
registration.tokenKeepPlaceholder: (leave empty to keep the current one)
registration.tokenHint: It is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before being persisted. The API never returns it in plain text.
registration.approverHint: Receives every request with 1-click approve/reject links. Empty = uses the global approver of the deployment, if any.
registration.telegramConfigRequired: To require Telegram, configure the bot (group and token) — without it the flow would be unavailable.

signupPolicy.title: Public signup
signupPolicy.description: Lets anyone create an account directly from /signup, without manual approval (role alumno by default). If your academy recruits students through enrollment requests or invitations, keep it off — it is the safe default.
signupPolicy.toggleTitle: Accept public signups in this tenant
signupPolicy.toggleHint: If the installation operator set AUTH_SIGNUP_ENABLED=true as an environment variable (meant only for development/testing), signup stays open for every tenant regardless of this switch.
